Title: POST /api/hr/query returns a policy answer for a valid question
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/hr/query with a JSON body containing a non-empty question | 2. Inspect the HTTP response
Expected Result: Response status is 200 and body is {"answer": "Employees accrue 1.5 days of paid leave per month, up to 18 days per year."}

Title: User chat message about insurance is routed end-to-end through the coordinator to the HR agent
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/coordinator/chat with a message containing the keyword "insurance" | 2. Confirm the coordinator dispatches to hr_agent.handle, which calls tools/hr_tool.answer_hr_question | 3. Inspect the HTTP response
Expected Result: Response status is 200 and body is {"agent": "hr_agent", "response": "The company insurance policy covers medical, dental, and vision for employees and dependents."}

Title: Whitespace-only question is treated as empty and rejected
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/hr/query with a question field containing only spaces | 2. Inspect the HTTP response
Expected Result: Response status is 400 with detail "question must not be empty" (the route's error handling converts the ValueError raised by tools/hr_tool.answer_hr_question into an HTTP 400 instead of a 500 or unhandled exception)

Title: POST /api/email/send accepts a well-formed email request
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/email/send with a valid recipient address, subject, and body | 2. Inspect the HTTP response
Expected Result: Response status is 200 and body is {"to": "employee@example.com", "subject": "Hello", "status": "sent"}

Title: POST /api/email/send rejects a malformed recipient address with a 400 instead of a 500
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/email/send with a "to" value that is not a valid email address | 2. Inspect the HTTP response and confirm no stack trace is leaked
Expected Result: Response status is 400 with a detail message identifying the invalid recipient address; no 500 error or unhandled exception occurs

Title: POST /api/search returns matching documents for a known keyword
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/search with a query matching an indexed document keyword | 2. Inspect the HTTP response
Expected Result: Response status is 200 and body includes a result with id "leave-policy"

Title: POST /api/search rejects an empty query string
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/search with an empty string query | 2. Inspect the HTTP response
Expected Result: Response status is 400 with detail "query must not be empty"

Title: Missing required field triggers FastAPI/Pydantic validation before route error handling runs
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/email/send with the "body" field omitted entirely | 2. Inspect the HTTP response
Expected Result: Response status is 422 (Pydantic request validation error) rather than the route's custom 400/500 handling, since the request never reaches the handler body

Title: POST /api/user accepts a valid user details submission
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/user with a valid name and email (phone/message optional) | 2. Inspect the HTTP response
Expected Result: Response status is 200 and body is {"status": "received", "name": "Jamie Rivera"}

Title: POST /api/user rejects an invalid email address with a 400 instead of a 500
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/user with a non-empty name but an email value with no "@" or domain | 2. Inspect the HTTP response
Expected Result: Response status is 400 with a detail message identifying the invalid email address; no unhandled server error occurs
